List live streams. Use this tool to list live streams for the authenticated user.

Usage:
  yutu liveStream list [flags]

Examples:
# List my live streams
yutu liveStream list --mine
# List live streams by ID
yutu liveStream list --ids stream1,stream2
# List live streams in JSON format
yutu liveStream list --mine --output json --maxResults 10

Flags:
  -h, --help                                   help for list
  -i, --ids strings                            Return live streams with the given ids
  -n, --maxResults int                         The maximum number of items that should be returned, 0 for no limit (default 5)
  -m, --mine                                   List streams owned by the authenticated user
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   Channel ID for content owner operations
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|table (default "table")
  -p, --parts strings                          Comma separated parts (default [id,snippet,cdn,status])
